entries.title: Psalms 67:1
segments: ¶<To the chief music-maker. With corded instruments. A Psalm. A Song.> May God give us mercy and blessing, and let the light of his face be shining on us; (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 67:2
segments: So that men may see your way on the earth, and your salvation among all nations.

entries.title: Psalms 67:3
segments: Let the peoples give you praise, O God; let all the peoples give you praise.

entries.title: Psalms 67:4
segments: O let the nations be glad, and make song of joy; for you will be the judge of the peoples in righteousness, guiding the nations of the earth. (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 67:5
segments: Let the peoples give you praise, O God; let all the peoples give you praise.

entries.title: Psalms 67:6
segments: The earth has given her increase; and God, even our God, will give us his blessing.

entries.title: Psalms 67:7
segments: God will give us his blessing; so let all the ends of the earth be in fear of him.
